levels.surface: عبد الملك بن شعيب بن الليث

notes: The first branch reaches Layth only through «عن جدي» (a relation); the tail after the last ح is shared, so the two branches meet at Layth.
The tail's «الليث» is the second occurrence; the first is inside «عبد الملك بن شعيب بن الليث».
The text's own last-branch tail ends at the Companion; the report continues beyond it, which the archive's flag about a further transmitter reflects.
